    def calculate_median(nums):
        # If the list has an odd number of elements, return the middle element.
        if len(nums) % 2 == 1:
            return nums[len(nums) // 2]
        # If the list has an even number of elements, calculate and return the median of the two middle elements.
        else:
            middle_index = len(nums) // 2
            return (nums[middle_index - 1] + nums[middle_index]) / 2

    def merge_sorted_lists(nums1, nums2):
        # Merge the two sorted lists into one new list.
        i, j = 0, 0
        merged_list = []

        while i < len(nums1) and j < len(nums2):
            if nums1[i] < nums2[j]:
                merged_list.append(nums1[i])
                i += 1
            else:
                merged_list.append(nums2[j])
                j += 1

        # Add the remaining elements from both lists.
        merged_list.extend(nums1[i:])
        merged_list.extend(nums2[j:])

        return merged_list

    # Merge the two sorted lists.
    merged_list = merge_sorted_lists(nums1, nums2)
    print(merged_list)  # Output: [1, 3]

        m, n = len(nums1), len(nums2)
